Our Approach

Precision. Discretion. Continuity.

Watch Our Video

A different definition of private medicine, one that begins with attention, and ends with outcomes measured in years, not appointments.

The Schoeman Clinic provides precision hormone and longevity medicine. Using advanced diagnostics, we target the root cause of health issues with bespoke plans authored to restore vitality, not merely manage symptoms.

Disciplines

Bespoke strategies for lasting vitality.

Three services, held together within a single, unified plan authored by your physician. Never in isolation.

Hormone Health & Optimisation

Bio-identical hormone therapy across every hormonal system, for men and women. Personalised protocols designed around your biochemistry, cadence and life.

View the service→

Longevity & Functional Medicine

Root-cause investigation across metabolic, gut, immune and environmental drivers, combined with proactive strategies to extend healthspan.

View the service→

Diagnostics & Supportive Services

Advanced biomarker panels, imaging and hormonal analysis, the foundation of every plan we author. Answers, not referrals.

View the service→
The Patient Journey

An unhurried path from understanding to optimisation.

Four stages, each conducted with the depth and privacy your circumstances demand. There is no template: only your biology, your intention, and your time.

As featured in

  1. Consultation

    Stage 1 of 4

    A private, unhurried appointment on Harley Street, in Wimbledon or virtually. We listen first: history, symptoms, ambition, context.

  2. Advanced Diagnostics

    Stage 2 of 4

    Comprehensive biomarker panels, hormonal profiles and functional testing: the root-cause portrait of your physiology.

  3. Personalised Strategy

    Stage 3 of 4

    A bespoke plan authored across all four pillars of medicine, reviewed by a clinician who holds the full credential stack.

  4. Continuous Optimisation

    Stage 4 of 4

    Ongoing measurement and refinement. Your doctor remains available between appointments, in person or in confidence.

The Schoeman Methodology

Four pillars. Held by every clinician.

Most multi-doctor clinics have one specialist per pillar. Here, every physician holds the full stack, so your care is never handed off, never fragmented, and never reduced to a referral.

Pillar I

Conventional Medicine

Higher training in conventional clinical medicine. The bedrock of safe, evidence-based diagnosis and treatment.

Pillar II

Hormone Therapy

Bio-identical hormone optimisation across all hormonal systems, for both men and women.

Pillar III

Functional Medicine

Root-cause investigation across metabolic, gut, immunological and environmental drivers of disease.

Pillar IV

Longevity Medicine

Proactive optimisation strategies designed to extend healthspan, resilience and quality of life.

In Confidence

“It's very rare to find a doctor that spends so much time analysing bloodwork and figuring out exactly what was needed to balance my metabolism and maximise my overall health. The best and most thoughtful health care expert I have ever worked with.”

Douglas Jackson Verified patient review

Shelly Nel Verified patient review
The Clinic

Two clinics. One considered standard of care.

Our Harley Street rooms sit within London’s historic medical quarter. Our Wimbledon practice offers the same standard of care in south-west London. Every consulting room is furnished for calm and designed for unhurried conversation.

Prefer to consult from home or abroad? Virtual appointments are available worldwide.
